home.how.title: How it works
home.how.lead: Three steps from a marketplace catalog to your own sales.
home.how.1.title: Connect marketplaces
home.how.1.text: Products, photos, prices and stock from Kaspi, Wildberries, Ozon and Yandex Market are imported automatically.
home.how.2.title: Set up your store
home.how.2.text: Pick a theme, set prices with a rule — say, 5% below the marketplace — and connect payments and delivery.
home.how.3.title: Sell directly
home.how.3.text: Customers order on your website, and the money lands in your account with no marketplace commission.
home.sellers.title: Benefits for sellers
home.sellers.lead: Your own sales channel that runs alongside the marketplaces.
home.sellers.1.title: No commission on sales
home.sellers.1.text: You pay a flat subscription instead of a percentage of every order, like on a marketplace.
home.sellers.2.title: Catalog in minutes
home.sellers.2.text: Products, photos and attributes are imported from your marketplace accounts — no manual data entry.
home.sellers.3.title: Up-to-date prices and stock
home.sellers.3.text: nado refreshes prices and stock from the marketplaces on a schedule.
home.sellers.4.title: Flexible pricing
home.sellers.4.text: A rule like “X% cheaper than the marketplace” with rounding, or a manual price for any product.
home.sellers.5.title: Money goes straight to you
home.sellers.5.text: Halyk ePay, Freedom Pay and Kaspi Pay are connected under your own contract — the platform never holds your money.
home.sellers.6.title: Your brand, your customers
home.sellers.6.text: Your logo, your own domain and a customer base that belongs to you, not to the marketplace.
home.buyers.title: Benefits for customers
home.buyers.lead: A convenient store worth coming back to.
home.buyers.1.title: Lower prices
home.buyers.1.text: The seller pays no marketplace commission and can offer a better price.
home.buyers.2.title: Delivery options
home.buyers.2.text: CDEK, Kazpost, courier or pickup — whatever suits you.
home.buyers.3.title: Sign in with your phone
home.buyers.3.text: No passwords: the login code arrives in WhatsApp or Telegram.
home.buyers.4.title: In your language
home.buyers.4.text: Stores in Kazakh, Russian and English, with light and dark themes.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.1.q: Do I have to leave the marketplace?
faq.1.a: No. nado runs alongside it: your products keep selling on the marketplace, and your own store adds a commission-free channel.
faq.2.q: How does customer money reach me?
faq.2.a: Straight into your account — through your own acquiring contract with Halyk ePay, Freedom Pay or Kaspi Pay. nado never receives or holds your money.
faq.3.a: Prices and stock are regularly imported from the marketplaces. A sale in your store doesn't reduce marketplace stock yet, so keep an eye on your best sellers.
faq.4.q: Do I need my own domain?
faq.4.a: No. Your store is available right away at an address like your-store.nado.kz. A custom domain is available on the Business and Pro plans.
faq.5.q: Do you take a percentage of sales?
faq.5.a: No. You only pay the flat subscription for your plan.
